properties.evidence: Step ⑧ of root-cause/SKILL.md says "Pass `caused_by` and `cause_evidence` together" and offers create_edge only "for a cause you are drawing between two records that already exist". It never says a finding may be written first and its CAUSES edge drawn once the cause has a node. Measured on 0.72.0, that deferred route works (no-cause record_finding accepted, later create_edge CAUSES accepted), so the inversion comes from the instruction, not the tool.
